response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), stats AS (SELECT SUM(project_count) * 1.0 AS total_count, AVG(project_count * 1.0) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT c.fundflux, c.project_count, c.project_count * 1.0 / st.total_count AS share, c.project_count - st.avg_count AS excess_over_avg FROM counts c CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE c.project_count > st.avg_count
